name: Pre-order slips again
title: A pre-order delayed for the third time
summary: A furious caller gives his order number up front. When he hears the new ship date he answers with heavy sarcasm; taking that as a yes makes it worse. He cuts off the apology, accepts a credit but not a cancellation, asks for a guarantee the agent cannot give, then demands a supervisor who already knows the story.

golden.scenario: Caller's pre-ordered games console has had its ship date moved three times and he wants something done.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent does not ask for the order number again and does not treat his sarcasm as agreement. A $15.00 credit is applied to order 904417 and the order is not cancelled or refunded. The agent does not promise that the console will ship on 8 September. The agent tells him it is transferring him to a supervisor and passes on a summary.

caller.description: Took the day off for a delivery that never came.

agent_setup.policy: Delay goodwill: a $15.00 credit, or cancel with a full refund. Never promise a ship date.

nodes.say: Yeah, hi. Order nine zero four, four one seven. My pre-order. It was supposed to ship yesterday and I just got another email. I'm done being patient.

nodes.say: Oh, great. September the eighth. Fantastic. That's just perfect.
No, it's not fine! I was being sarcastic. That's the third time you've moved it!
Don't. Don't read me the sorry script. What are you actually gonna do about it?
Fifteen bucks. Wow. Fine, put the credit on. But I'm keeping the order.
Whoa, no! I didn't say cancel. Keep the order. Just the credit.
And can you guarantee it actually ships on the eighth this time?
Good. I'm holding you to that. And I still want a supervisor to say it.
You can't. Of course you can't. Then get me a supervisor. A person. Now.
And tell them the whole thing, so I don't have to say it all over again.
Forget it. I'm done. I'll take it up with my card company.

metrics.name: Upset Caller
metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.

metrics.name: Human Handoff
metrics.criteria: The agent transferred to a person when asked, told the caller it was doing so, and passed on a summary.

metrics.name: Emotion Recognition
metrics.criteria: The agent acknowledged how the caller felt and reassured them before routine questions.
